data.text: [00:03.5]I’ve got an article here about the Mozart Effect ... . `[00:08]It says music can affect your mood. `[00:11]You know, different music makes you feel happy or relaxed or something. `[00:16]I don’t know about that – can music change how you feel? Ermm ... what do you think?

[00:23]Erm I don’t know, I think maybe when you’re in a bad mood or upset about something, and you put happy music on, it makes you feel better. `[00:34]Yeah, I think music can change your mood ... but maybe also, it depends what kind of person you are I suppose ... and what kind of music you like.

[00:45]Sometimes I like listening to music that reminds me of old times. `[00:49.9]You know, I put on a song the other day and it really reminded me of my summer holidays a few years ago. `[00:56]I remember listening to it when I went to Italy with my family. `[00:59.9]It’s got great memories, I suppose and it made me feel really good, you know, listening to it again.
[01:06.9]Yeah, I know what you mean ... . How often do you listen to music, then?

[01:11.9]I listen to music every single day... erm ... all day, sometimes! `[01:17]From the moment I wake up, the radio is on ... or the MP3 player. `[01:22.3]I never go anywhere without my MP3 player ... even when I’m out on my bike.
[01:27.7]So, do you listen to music when you’re travelling? `[01:30.7]You know, when you’re going to work or something?

[01:33]Yeah ... that’s a really good time for listening to music. `[01:37]I have the radio on in the car, and it makes the journey go quicker. `[01:41.7]You know, you can sing along ... and have fun when you’re sitting in a traffic jam!
[01:47]What’s your favourite type of music?

[01:49.7]Erm I love all kinds of music ... anything that’s good. `[01:54.9]I love old stuff, I love new stuff. `[01:58]My favourite type is probably rock, but lots of other stuff too. `[02:04]Erm I think that it’s quite difficult to say your favourite, especially because I listen to so much music.
[02:12.3]What about live music – when did you last see live music?

[02:17]Oh, it was ages ago. `[02:19.8]The last concert I saw was years ago. `[02:23]Erm ... mmm, I don’t know why, I suppose it’s really expensive usually and sometimes the place is so big, you can’t really see the person properly. `[02:35]I’m not really bothered about live music so much ...
